name: RealmAI
subcategory: general purpose LLM chat and content generation
tagline: A general purpose AI assistant: chat with a hosted model, save prompts, generate text.

pricing.notes: AI-drafted from a site submission; price unverified.

verdictSummary: Public detail on this one is thin, so treat the specifics as unconfirmed. What is clear is the shape: an assistant layer sitting on top of models that someone else trains and hosts, with a chat UI, a prompt library, and some formatting polish on the output. That shape is the single most one-shottable category on this directory, because the part that costs billions is rented through an API key you can rent too. A coding agent gives you a local chat app with streaming, conversation history, system prompts, and model switching in an afternoon. You pay the model provider directly and skip the margin.
coreLoopDIY: A local web app that streams chat completions from a hosted model, stores conversations in SQLite, and lets you save and reuse system prompts.
requirements: An API key from an LLM provider, OpenAI or Anthropic
Node 20 and a machine to run it on
Willingness to pay per token instead of per month
whatYouLose: Mobile apps and anything resembling sync between devices
Whatever prompt tuning and output formatting they did that you will now do yourself, badly, for a week
Shared workspaces, if the product has them
Someone else's problem when the upstream provider changes models or rate limits you
File uploads, RAG over your documents, and image handling unless you build each one
moatNotes: An assistant wrapper's only durable edge is taste: the defaults, the prompt scaffolding, the moment where it just returns the right thing. That is real work, but it is copyable work.
whyPeopleStillPay: Because a subscription is one decision and a self-hosted assistant is a hundred small ones: key rotation, cost caps, streaming edge cases, what to do when the context window fills, whether you want this running on your laptop when your laptop is asleep. Most people want an app icon and a monthly charge, not a repo. If the pricing is low and the defaults are good, paying is rational even though building is easy.
notes: Rented intelligence with a UI on top, which means the UI is the product and the UI is a weekend.
prompt:
Build a local, single user AI assistant web app. No accounts, no cloud, no telemetry.

Stack, non negotiable:
- Next.js 15 with the App Router and TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS for styling, no component library
- SQLite via better-sqlite3, file at ./data/app.db, schema created on first boot
- Anthropic and OpenAI SDKs, keys read from .env.local only

Features in scope:
1. Chat view: message list, textarea composer, send on Cmd+Enter. Responses stream token by token via the Vercel AI SDK or a plain ReadableStream route handler.
2. Conversations persisted in SQLite: id, title, model, created_at, plus a messages table. Auto title a conversation from the first user message after the first reply.
3. Sidebar listing conversations with search over message text, rename, and delete.
4. Model picker in the header that switches between at least one Anthropic and one OpenAI model. Store the choice per conversation.
5. Prompt library: a saved_prompts table with name and body. Apply one as the system prompt for a new conversation, edit and delete from a simple settings page.
6. Markdown rendering of assistant output with fenced code blocks, syntax highlighting, and a copy button per block.
7. Token and cost estimate per conversation, computed from usage returned by the API, displayed in the footer. Hardcode a small price table in one file and label it as an estimate.
8. Export a conversation to markdown.

Out of scope, do not build:
- Auth, multi user, billing, analytics, any external service beyond the model APIs
- File uploads, RAG, vector search, image generation, voice
- Docker, CI, tests beyond a smoke check that the DB opens

Deliver: working app, .env.example listing ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and OPENAI_API_KEY, and a README with setup in under ten lines. Run npm run build at the end and fix anything that breaks.
